segments.sn46.20:1.1: “Sattime, bhikkhave, bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.sn46.20:1.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo – ime kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
segments.sn46.20:2.1: Pāṇā sūriyūpamā dve, gilānā apare tayo;
segments.sn46.20:2.3: Pāraṅgāmī viraddho ca, ariyo nibbidāya cāti.

lines: 195-201. Catutthe tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosīti therassa kira imaṃ bojjhaṅgabhāvanaṃ sādhukaṃ suṇantassa etadahosi “mayhaṃ pabbajitadivasato sattame divase saccāni paṭivijjhantassa ime bojjhaṅgā pātubhūtā”ti.
Athassa “niyyānikaṃ vata satthusāsanan”ti cintayato lohitaṃ pasīdi, upādārūpaṃ visuddhaṃ ahosi, pokkharapatte patitaudakabindu viya sarīrato rogo vinivattitvā gato.
Tena vuttaṃ “tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosī”ti.
Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi janānaṃ pabbatapāde pupphitavisarukkhavātasamphassena uppanno mandasītajaro ābādhoti veditabbo.
Eseva nayo pāḷito atthato ca catutthena pañcamachaṭṭhānaṃ samānattā.
